scope: Literal v1 make_report outputs generated solely from git-archived original baseline source. These are compatibility snapshots only, not an independent semantic oracle or evidence of actual Blender/controller execution. Known incorrect passes are intentionally preserved.

provenance.fixture_geometry: Hand-derived outward tetrahedron adapted from translated_v1_probe.py
provenance.baseline_export_path_note: Generation imported only original baseline package from a separate temporary directory; no modified evaluator was imported.

canonical_hash_contract: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(report, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), allow_nan=False)
